verdict.rationale: Exporting account data in open formats is a fair question for a payments and stablecoin service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no data-export capability. Sending stablecoins to external wallets moves funds, not data, and the API, MCP server and CLI are developer building blocks rather than a documented export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
